hero.bio: Engineer. I like <accent>efficient solutions to hard problems</accent>, and interfaces that feel good to use.

projects.title: Projects
projects.intro: A few things I built because the problem was interesting.

items.crimp-studio: Climbing wall route setter with draggable 3D holds, procedural route generation and undo/redo history.
items.coast-to-cup: Which 2026 World Cup path carries the worst logistics, group stage through the final: travel, circadian shift, altitude and heat, modelled against a base camp.
items.hiit-maker: Interval training builder for workouts you set round by round, installable and usable offline.
items.vscodethemes-scrapper: Drop a screenshot of your editor and it names the VS Code theme, in your browser, against 32,742 crawled themes.
items.arkham-theme: Dark VS Code theme with 24,000+ installs on the marketplace, based on Transylvania and Mayukai.
items.pixel-algorithms: Grid algorithms you can scrub through: A*, flood fill, Bresenham, dithering, marching squares.
items.claude-checkpoint-diagram: Draws a Mermaid checkpoint diagram at each pause in an agent run.
items.claude-doc-tdd: TDD for facts: an executable check per claim before anything is published.
items.claude-visual-options: Renders three or four real candidates at a visual fork and asks you to pick, instead of choosing for you.
items.claude-enhance-me: Names an architectural fork before the code exists and withholds its own lean, so you reason the tradeoff through.
items.claude-handoff: Writes a session handoff before compaction takes the context, so a fresh session resumes mid-task.
